**B&W**
**BROWN & WILLIAMSON TOBACCO CORPORATION**

April 3, 1974

Mr. Charles Wiley
c/o Allen-Martin Productions
9701 Taylorsville Road
Louisville, Kentucky 40299

Dear Mr. Wiley:

This is to confirm my request that you arrange to print for VICEROY, four full ASI ads for Time-size keylines. We will need your quote by 4/10.

**I. Ad Description**

A. Names and Numbers:
1. "Flying Car - Mortise" - V-MG-74-11
2. "Blurred Car - Mortise" - V-MG-74-12
3. "Gold Trophy - Mortise" - V-MG-74-13
4. "32 Drivers - Mortise" - V-MG-74-14

B. Please include the following information on these ads:
1. Ad Name
2. Ad Number
3. Magazine

**II. Quantity requirements and specifications:**

800 copies each on 50# Patina
7" x 10" printed on stock
13-1/2" x 16" (Min.) and
23" x 20" (Max.)

**III. Timetable**

First Proof - 4/12
Complete - 4/17
Ads to L.A. - 4/19
